description: The tree edges for a Prüfer code, as a flat list of sorted pairs. Code 2,3 is the path 1-2-3-4. Code 1,1 is the star at 1. An empty code is the edge 1-2. Code entries run from 1 to 30. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/prufer-decode
